description_en: Unlocks a single IoT card for device rebinding
name: RebindCards

parameters.help_en: The ICCIDs of the IoT SIM cards. You can specify up to 500 ICCIDs at a time
parameters.help_zh: 物联网SIM卡卡号，每次最大500条
parameters.name: iccids

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.
If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the client token. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on the request. Valid values:
true: performs only a dry run and does not delete the batch card operation task. The system checks whether the required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, the batch card operation task is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除批量操作卡任务。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后删除批量操作卡任务
parameters.name: dry_run
